description: Estimates how many more people and store visits this Xyla shop could get each month with Boost, Xyla's always-on ads for the store, at a daily budget of $5 to $50. Use it when the merchant asks how to get more reach, followers, traffic or sales. Compares against the shop's own post reach and links to the Boost page in Xyla.

daily_budget_dollars.description: Daily budget in whole dollars. Defaults to 10, Xyla's suggestion.
